reasoning: The old foe is Radoje the Tanner. Decades on, his grandson turns up destitute in an Alexandria debtor's market; Xene, on an impulse of guilt she won't examine, buys his freedom. Checks the last untouched original trade Skill to do it.

operations.name: Dragan
operations.description: Radoje the Tanner's grandson, sold into an Alexandria debtor's market; I bought his freedom on a whim I don't examine too closely

operations.text: In an Alexandria debtor's market I recognize a tanner's ring on a starving boy's hand — Radoje's own grandson Dragan, sold off for his grandfather's debts — and some old, unaccountable guilt makes me weigh out coral enough to buy his freedom.
